test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following best represents the relationship among Doctors, Males, and Surgeons?

options.text: All Surgeons are Doctors and some Doctors are Males
All Surgeons are Males and some Males are Doctors
All Surgeons are Doctors and all Doctors are Males
All Surgeons are Doctors; some Doctors are Males, and some Surgeons are Males

solution:
Given:

All Surgeons are Doctors 

Some Doctors can be Males 

Some Surgeons can also be Males 

Now, Checking the given options:

Option 1) All Surgeons are Doctors and some Doctors are Males → Incomplete (does not show Surgeons–Males relation)

Option 2) All Surgeons are Males → Incorrect (not necessary)

Option 3) All Doctors are Males → Incorrect (not necessary)

Option 4) All Surgeons are Doctors; some Doctors are Males, and some Surgeons are Males →** Correct **

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
